messages:
elaine: Heads-up: onboarding 70B-beta to Dedicated. Need a quick capacity calc across H100/A100 in US/EU/APAC. Target p99 latency <= 220ms and p95 throughput >= 6 tps per GPU at 8 concurrent sessions. Anyone have bench numbers with q4f16 + tiled kernel?
raj: I ran microbench on H100-80GB and A100-40GB with q4f16 last night. H100 @8-conc p99 ~180ms, throughput ~7.2 tps. A100 @8-conc p99 ~260ms, throughput ~5.1 tps.
maria: thanks — do we have warmup/KV penalty measured? saw ~40ms first-token penalty on H100 for cold KV cache, drops after 2 tokens.
tyler: for Dedicated sizing assume 20% autoscale headroom. If target sustained requests = 480 tps per region, quick calc: H100 ~7.2 tps => 480/7.2 = ~67 gpus, with 20% headroom => ~80. A100 ~5.1 tps => 480/5.1 = ~94 gpus, with headroom => ~113.
zhang: kernel choice matters; using tiled attention kernel on H100 reduced p99 by ~30-40ms in our runs. On A100 tiling helps but benefits smaller. Also q8_0 reduced latency ~10-12% but we saw small quality drift on evals.
raj: adding numbers as code calc for clarity:
```
# sustained_load = 480 tps
H100_tp = 7.2
A100_tp = 5.1
H100_needed = ceil(480 / H100_tp)  # ~67
A100_needed = ceil(480 / A100_tp)  # ~94
with_headroom = lambda n: ceil(n * 1.2)  # ~80 vs ~113
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started on us-west-2-dedicated pool (3 gpus).
elaine: Proposed plan: start with mixed pool (60% H100 + 40% A100) in US/EU, reserve +25% extra capacity for APAC regional spikes, autoscale buffer 20%, set tiled kernel on H100, fallback to standard kernel on A100. Any objections? :eyes: 
raj: +1. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for chat flows — saves ~15% token compute and lowers tail latency.
maria: note — onboarding eval found a small quality regression on prompt family #4 when we tried q8_0. Keep q4f16 flagged as default for now and revisit after more evals.
tyler: I'll spin a 30-day runway sim with diurnal spikes and multi-region skew, then drop results in the shared sheet: https://redwood.drive/sheets/dedicated-70b-sizing (will include headroom curves).
elaine: Perfect. I'll update the Dedicated runbook and create the capacity order. @infra-team can you provision 20 GPUs in us-west-2 (mixed H100/A100) to start the canary-to-scale?
infra-bot: Request filed: provision 20 GPUs (mix H100/A100). ETA ~48h.
